    # Separator rows/columns of 9 divide the canvas into cells. Mark cells
    # containing two or more 5s with 1; leave the rest as 3.
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 9 for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if all(row[j] == 9 for row in grid)]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]) for c in range(cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]))

        out.append(line)
    return out
